paragraphs: (The father of the prophet Jeremiah.) Rabbi Yitzchak bar Chilkiyah: Vayikra Rabbah 30:3. Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiyah: Yoma 2a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Yoma 2a fully writes Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiyah. This supports Rav for the supplied abbreviation ר׳, without changing the separate Yitzchak notice.

The whole Torat Emet Vayikra Rabbah 30:3 paragraph spells out Rabbi Yitzchak beRabbi Chilkiyah. The selected Davidson Yoma 2a paragraph spells out Rav Minyomi bar Chilkiyah, supporting the two local full titles. Jeremiah 1:1 independently names Jeremiah son of Chilkiyah as a positive biblical comparison. These three pointers do not establish one common father or bind the biblical Chilkiyah to the rabbinic patronymics. The supplied Yoma locator ב.., including its doubled period, remains a source feature beside the digital 2a comparison.
